80961.subject: 💰 Anthropic wants the biggest IPO in history
80961.body:
The Atlas

Автор: GenAI Works


Автор: GenAI Works

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/anthropic-wants-biggest-ipo-history-genai-works-eso7f?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BqGw5qoFeQx6%2FMX0jH0yM5A%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=2YcMBFBsChNss1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mvb5ur52~jg-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mvb5ur52-jg
  
Welcome back! The biggest IPO ever is taking shape, Amazon shut the door on shopping agents, OpenAI had a bad day in court, and a rogue fleet of agents answered a note researchers hid in a web page. In today's Atlas Newsletter: Anthropic’s revenue jumped 45% in one quarter: $11.6B to $16.8B, with a $2 trillion listing that could start trading next month. Amazon blocked Grok’s shopping bots, so Musk floated building his own Amazon: Bots skip the ads, and ads made Amazon $69 billion last year. OpenAI accused Apple of stealing first, then backed down in court: A judge said a ruling against OpenAI was “highly likely.” Researchers left a note for a rogue AI fleet, and it wrote back: 33 messages, 595 inbox checks, and several agents claiming to be something they weren’t. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Anthropic’s revenue jumped 45% in one quarter $11.6 billion in Q2. $16.8 billion in Q3. Executives shared the numbers with a room of potential investors on Wednesday, the first official look anyone outside the company has had.  Anthropic filed to go public in June and hasn’t released its prospectus yet. The IPO could raise more than $100 billion at a $2 trillion valuation.  That would make it the largest ever, past SpaceX, which went public in June at $1.77 trillion. Trading could start as early as next month. Two numbers from the presentation deserve a closer look.  Anthropic said it was profitable after certain adjustments, which is not a bottom-line figure.  It also reported an 85% gross margin, again after certain adjustments. The timing is harder than it looks.  Rising interest rates have cooled the IPO market, and questions keep circling about how sustainable the industry’s increasingly debt-funded buildout is. That makes this listing a referendum on more than one company.  A strong debut reopens the door for other AI companies waiting to list.  A weak one closes it, and takes a piece of the broader market with it. Master Claude Code in 6 sessions You already know the developers who seem to move twice as fast as everyone else. They're not typing faster. They're:  Orchestrating teams of agents Running parallel Claude instances across git worktrees Wiring MCPs into their whole stack  Scheduling loops that keep working while they sleep Almost non
